raw.reasoning: Relayfile configurations move between hosts; accepting /github and /GitHub on a case-sensitive machine creates concurrent Syncers over one directory when used on common case-insensitive macOS or Windows filesystems. Rejecting at the shared scope boundary makes the portable configuration safe by construction.

retrospective.summary: Rejected case-folded scoped-root overlaps and mixed-case reserved runtime directories; focused mountscope tests and full go vet/go test suite pass.
